senses.definition: n.pr.m. (cf. perhaps Arabic يُمْنٌ good fortune يَمْنَةٌ right side)—
a son of Asher Gn 46:17; Nu 26:44, also (for adj. gent.) הַיִּמְנָה v 44 = the family of the Yimnites 1 Ch 7:30.
a Levite 2 Ch 31:14.
